explanation: For every possible starting position, scan fixed-length word chunks. Count each chunk and reject unknown words or counts exceeding the required dictionary multiplicities.
timeComplexity: O(nkL), for text length n, k words and word length L, including substring copying/hashing
spaceComplexity: O(kL) temporary chunk/count storage plus output
